name: Vampire court
description: Black, red and white Vampires that drain life, grow with +1/+1 counters and sacrifice their own for gain – with two commanders, a lord and the spells to back them up.

cards.name: Odrava, Matriarch of the Crimson Court
cards.rule_text:
Flying
At the beginning of your end step, if you gained life this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on each Vampire you control.
Whenever another Vampire you control dies, each opponent loses 1 life.
cards.flavor_text: Her court never sleeps, and it is never hungry for long.

cards.name: Vask, Heir of Embers
cards.rule_text:
Menace
At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may sacrifice another creature. If you do, put a +1/+1 counter on each Vampire you control.
Whenever you sacrifice another Vampire, you draw a card and you lose 1 life.

cards.name: Herald of the Scarlet Banquet
cards.rule_text:
Other Vampires you control get +1/+1.
{1}{B}, Sacrifice another Vampire: Each opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
cards.flavor_text: Every guest is welcome. Few of them leave.

cards.name: Candle-Lit Fledgling
cards.rule_text:
Lifelink
Whenever you gain life, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME. This ability triggers only once each turn.

cards.name: Ember-Fanged Courier
cards.rule_text:
Haste
Whenever CARDNAME attacks, you may sacrifice another creature. If you do, put two +1/+1 counters on CARDNAME.

cards.name: Duskchapel Acolyte
cards.rule_text:
Lifelink
When CARDNAME enters, put a +1/+1 counter on up to one other target Vampire you control.
cards.flavor_text: She lights the candles at sunset and puts them out at dawn.

cards.name: Collector of the Red Debt
cards.rule_text: Whenever another creature you control dies, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
cards.flavor_text: Every debt is paid in the end. He only decides the currency.

cards.name: Vigil-Blade of the Red Court
cards.rule_text:
Double strike
Whenever another Vampire you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.

cards.name: Banquet Hall Steward
cards.rule_text: When CARDNAME enters, you may sacrifice another creature. If you do, draw two cards.

cards.name: Cinder-Cloak Viscount
cards.rule_text:
Flying
Whenever you sacrifice another creature, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each opponent.

cards.name: Pale Abbess of the Long Night
cards.rule_text:
Flying, lifelink
At the beginning of your end step, if you gained 3 or more life this turn, create a 1/1 black Vampire creature token with lifelink.

cards.name: Elder of the Thirsting Dark
cards.rule_text:
Flying
When CARDNAME enters, each opponent loses 3 life and you gain 3 life.
Whenever another Vampire you control dies, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.
cards.flavor_text: It has outlived every kingdom that tried to bury it.

cards.name: Gallows-Hall Executioner
cards.rule_text:
Menace
When CARDNAME enters, you may sacrifice another creature. When you do, destroy target creature an opponent controls.

cards.name: Feast at Midnight
cards.rule_text: Each opponent loses X life and you gain X life, where X is the number of Vampires you control.
cards.flavor_text: The bells strike twelve, and the doors are locked from the inside.

cards.name: Vow of the Red Court
cards.rule_text: Put a +1/+1 counter on each Vampire you control. Vampires you control gain lifelink until end of turn.

cards.name: Price of the Red Feast
cards.rule_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature.
Destroy target creature or planeswalker. You gain life equal to the sacrificed creature's power.

cards.name: Toast to the Endless Night
cards.rule_text: CARDNAME deals 3 damage to target creature or planeswalker. If you control a Vampire, you gain 2 life.

cards.name: Goblet of the Scarlet Court
cards.rule_text:
{T}: Add {W}, {B}, or {R}. Spend this mana only to cast a Vampire spell.
{2}, {T}, Sacrifice a creature: You gain 2 life and draw a card.

cards.name: Night of Long Teeth
cards.rule_text:
Whenever a Vampire you control deals combat damage to a player, put a +1/+1 counter on that Vampire.
Whenever a Vampire you control dies, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.

cards.name: Crimson Court Ballroom
cards.rule_text:
{T}: Add {C}.
{T}: Add {W}, {B}, or {R}. Spend this mana only to cast a Vampire spell.
cards.flavor_text: The music never stops, and nobody remembers arriving.
